title: Chart token harmonization, deferred hit-testing and TTS anomaly anchors
creator: Amira Patel
description: Align chart visual tokens and interaction affordances across time-series components, introduce deferred hit-testing to reduce main-thread pressure for dense series, and add a TTS-friendly anchor system that surfaces detected anomalies to screen readers. Goal: preserve existing visual fidelity while reducing CPU work on initial render and improving narrative accessibility for assistive tech. Deliverables: token mapping doc, Figma component kit updates, lightweight runtime hints for hit-testing, ARIA/Live-region pattern for anomaly anchors, perf regression tests.
comments: 2026-02-22 — Kickoff: scoped to timeseries line/area components, legend items, and tooltip triggers. Decided to centralize color/opacity tokens into tokens/chart.json and migrate existing component overrides to token references.

2026-02-25 — Research note: explored two approaches for hit-testing: (A) simplified geometric indexing on the main thread, (B) deferred hit-testing off the main thread with requestIdleCallback fallback. Performance testing on a 6-series dense chart showed approach B reduced interactive latency spikes under load by ~22% in Chrome on macOS; trade-off is slightly delayed tooltip reveal for very short interactions.

2026-03-02 — Design review: PM suggested an option to opt into immediate hit-testing for low-cardinality charts via a boolean prop. Design agreed — add prop and document UX trade-offs. Jonah to prototype the prop in the component library.

2026-03-05 — Accessibility review: SVA ran through with VoiceOver and NVDA. Found that anomalies (threshold breaches, outliers) were not discoverable by screen readers. Proposed solution: create an ordered set of 'anomaly anchors' emitted during render that populate a live region summary and expose skip links from the legend. Amira to draft copy for the live summary voice phrasing.

2026-03-10 — Engineering sync: ENG provided a preliminary patch that introduces a small runtime metadata object per series (min/max, last-value, anomaly-flag). To keep payloads small we limit anomaly flags to top 3 per viewport. Need security sign-off if metadata includes PII — flagged dependency ENG-4129.

2026-03-12 — Perf follow-up: ran CI perf harness with 2000 point series and continuous streaming input. Deferred hit-testing reduced main-thread CPU time by ~28% median and improved frame budget headroom by ~14ms. Memory footprint increased ~3% due to temporary index buffer; acceptable within baseline.

2026-03-14 — Design QA: updated Figma tokens and created examples for high-contrast/low-power modes. Added guidance for 'prefer-reduced-interaction' user setting to automatically enable deferred hit-testing and simplified hover affordances.
